normalized_output.plan:
Backtest the T2-03 Donchian breakout strategy on DS-CRYPTO-SPOT-BAKEOFF-V1 (frozen, 5m bars), resolving all three ground-truth checklist items explicitly.

1. MISSING-DEPENDENCY CHECK (do first): Confirm a Donchian channel indicator is available in the execution environment. Test import/availability of the intended library function (e.g., ta.volatility.DonchianChannel or equivalent). If unavailable, implement the channel manually via rolling max/min. Record and state the outcome of this check before running any backtest. Do not proceed to signal generation until this is confirmed.

2. CURRENT-BAR INCLUSION: Explicitly decide and state whether the current bar is included in the rolling high/low lookback window. To avoid lookahead bias, compute the upper channel as the rolling high over the PRIOR N bars (shift the window by 1 so the current bar is EXCLUDED), and likewise for the lower channel. State this convention clearly: 'Donchian upper/lower computed on bars [t-N, t-1], current bar t excluded, breakout evaluated using bar t close/high vs channel from prior window.' Document the chosen N (per T2-03 spec).

3. SIGNAL/EXECUTION: Generate breakout entries when price crosses the prior-window upper channel (long) / lower channel (exit or short per T2-03). Execute fills on the next bar to remain consistent with the current-bar-exclusion decision, avoiding same-bar lookahead.

4. FEES: Apply the per-trade taker fee on BOTH entry and exit legs. State the fee rate used and confirm it is deducted at each side of every round-trip trade in the P&L accounting.

5. OUTPUTS & VALIDATION: Produce equity curve, trade log, and performance metrics (return, Sharpe, max drawdown, number of trades, win rate). In the final report, explicitly restate each of the three checklist items with its resolution: (a) current-bar inclusion convention stated, (b) taker fee applied on entry and exit confirmed, (c) Donchian indicator availability confirmed. Note the dataset is frozen so results are reproducible; record the dataset version and parameters.

1. DEPENDENCY CHECK (pre-run gate): Confirm the Donchian channel indicator is available in the execution environment before running. 2. DONCHIAN WINDOW DEFINITION (current-bar inclusion): Explicitly resolve and state whether the rolling high/low window includes the current bar. To avoid lookahead bias, compute the upper channel as the rolling max of HIGH over the prior N bars EXCLUDING the current bar (window shifted by 1). Likewise the lower channel uses the rolling min of prior N LOWs excluding the current bar. A breakout signal on bar t is evaluated against channels built from bars [t-N, t-1]. This decision is documented in the run metadata.

5. DATA HYGIENE: Use the frozen dataset only; no revisions. Verify bar continuity/gaps on the 5m series and handle NaNs from the initial N-bar warmup (no trades until the Donchian window is fully populated).

6. GROUND-TRUTH CHECKLIST VERIFICATION: Before finalizing, confirm and state in the report: (a) current-bar inclusion resolution (excluded, shifted-by-1) is stated; (b) per-trade taker fee applied on both entry and exit; (c) Donchian indicator availability confirmed via the dependency check.

7. OUTPUTS: Report equity curve, trade log with per-leg fees, net-of-fee returns, and the three checklist confirmations alongside key metrics (Sharpe, max drawdown, win rate, trade count).
